parts.title: Check you're eligible
parts.body: Over the next 3 months you and your partner (if you have one) must each expect to earn at least £2,643.68 if you're aged 21 or over.

parts.title: What you'll get
parts.body: 30 hours per week of free childcare for 38 weeks of the year.

change_history.note: Earnings thresholds updated for the 2026 to 2027 tax year.
Expanded to children aged 9 months and over.
